def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
def save(name, value):
    path = EVIDENCE / name
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with path.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump(value, stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
        stream.write("\n")
def emit(kind, value):
    print(json.dumps({"kind": kind, **value}, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
def command(label, args, *, cwd=None, child_env=None, timeout=180):
    path = EVIDENCE / (label + ".console.log")
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    started = time.monotonic()
    result = {"label": label, "command": args, "cwd": str(cwd or ROOT),
              "timeout_seconds": timeout, "timed_out": False, "exit_code": None}
    with path.open("xb") as out:
        try:
            completed = subprocess.run(args, cwd=cwd or ROOT, env=child_env or env,
                                       stdout=out, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=timeout)
            result["exit_code"] = completed.returncode
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            result["timed_out"] = True
    result.update({"elapsed_seconds": time.monotonic() - started,
                   "log": str(path.relative_to(EVIDENCE)),
                   "log_bytes": path.stat().st_size, "log_sha256": sha(path.read_bytes())})
    SUMMARY["commands"].append(result)
    save(label + ".command.json", result)
    emit("command", {"label": label, "exit_code": result["exit_code"],
                     "timed_out": result["timed_out"]})
    return result

def source_manifest():

    selected = sorted(p for p in names if p and (

        p in EXPECTED_SOURCES))

    for name in selected:

            + "    origin = Path(importlib.util.find_spec(name).origin).resolve()\n"
            + "    assert str(origin) == wanted, (name,str(origin),wanted)\n"
